x: A young member who deserves the highest praise from us and the heartiest of congratulations is Rodney Heward-Mills. Competing for Somerset in the English Schools' Championships at the Crystal Palace on July 9/10 in the Senior Boys' Triple Jump, he achieved 50' 9" (15.47m.) and set up a U.K.

Steve White jumped 7.08m or 23ft 2¾ins but only managed seventh and Rodney Heward-Mills qualified for the final of the Triple Jump. An Inter-Club meeting at Chiswick on the last day of May saw the Bel's turn out in force in the 800m to show what depth we have in this event.
